items.title: Scrap junk to produce Cloth
items.detail: Craft Bulk Cloth at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it for fastest completion.

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Take from a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P., or find one at various locations.

items.title: Kill a Legendary Enemy
items.detail: Join public events like Eviction Notice, Radiation Rumble, or Uranium Fever.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Enter Daily Ops and kill a Phantom; you don't need to complete the operation.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Glass
items.detail: Craft Bulk Glass at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it for fastest completion.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint on foot without fast traveling; running near Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center works well.

items.title: Use Photomode while in a Team
items.detail: Join any team and open Photomode to take a photo.

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your shelter, use build menu, select Decorations category, and place any item.

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is convenient.

items.title: Collect RadAway or Rad-X
items.detail: Collect from world loot or craft diluted versions at a chemistry station.

items.title: Collect Soap
items.detail: Find at The Whitespring Resort bathrooms, or collect from a Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron.

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Take from a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Eat a Vegetable
items.detail: Harvest and eat any raw vegetable like Tato, Corn, or Razorgrain.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Enter Daily Ops and kill a Phantom; completion of the operation is not required.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find an active Infestation on the map and eliminate Phantoms within the hotspot.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: All rewards from Mutated Party Packages are available during this event.

events.name: Double SCORE Weekend and Murmrgh's Special Pick
events.description: Earn double SCORE on challenges and access Murmrgh's special weapons inventory.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Community competition to design the best themed C.A.M.P. builds.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Spooky-themed event with new rewards for costumed trick-or-treating activities.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance of catching seasonal fish during this weekend event.
